summary: {person} appoints a committee to find which agency rules stand in the way of an executive order.
realLife: Harry Truman gave a committee the job of examining military practices and recommending changes to carry out equal treatment.
gates: An executive policy change requires agencies to examine their existing rules.
weights: More agencies working under different rules favor a joint review.
inGame: needs: recommendations for changing agency regulations.

turns.what: The executive directs an immediate rule change.
turns.pulledBy: A legal review identifies the specific rule and authority to amend it.
turns.writesBack: The order names the rule and effective date.

turns.what: The committee starts with one agency.
turns.pulledBy: That agency has complete records while the others are collecting theirs.
turns.writesBack: The first report covers a named agency only.
